description: This file is a PHP web page script that presents a web form for changing the router's admin password as part of a setup wizard. It includes HTML, JavaScript for form validation and user interface interactions, and server-side PHP includes for headers, navigation, and footer.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the user instance number based on the logged-in username.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends configuration data via AJAX to the server to update settings, then handles the response.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates input and initiates password change process.
